document_type.Kontoauszug: Bank documents about account movements: account statements, credit advices (Gutschriftsanzeige) and debit advices (Belastungsanzeige).
document_type.Gutschrift: A credit note from a merchant or supplier that refunds or reduces an earlier invoice. Not a bank credit advice (Gutschriftsanzeige) - that is a Kontoauszug.
document_type.Rechnung: An invoice or bill requesting payment for goods or services.
document_type.Vertrag: A contract or agreement signed by the parties, including purchase and subscription contracts.
document_type.Schreiben: A general letter or notice that is not an invoice, contract or bank document.

tag.Steuerrelevant: The document is needed for the annual tax return (e.g. salary statements, donation receipts, bank interest, insurance premiums, property).
